definitions.ask: What should the footer run indicator show beside its spinner?
definitions.why: Says bob is busy, and for how long, without crowding the status bar

choices.label: Shows `bob 0:42`; the command name moves to the hover tooltip; narrow and steady
Shows the run's title and clock, like today's chip; up to ~200px wide, shifts between runs
Spinner only (plus ×2 when several run); time and name appear only on hover

definitions.ask: Should the indicator count every run the command-mode engine owns, not only `:` sheet runs?
definitions.why: One engine, one honest busy signal; a writer queued behind a hidden run would look stuck

choices.label: Sheet, palette, toast-action, and sibling-plugin API runs all light it
Only runs started from the `:` sheet; palette and API runs stay invisible
